chunks: As for what Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn Maḥbūb narrated from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Mūsā ibn al-Qāsim, from ʿAlī ibn Jaʿfar, from his brother Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليه السلام, he said:

I asked him about a man who remembered, while he was in his salat (prayer), that he had not performed istinjāʾ after relieving himself. He said: He should leave, perform istinjāʾ after relieving himself, and repeat the salat (prayer). But if he remembers after having finished his salat (prayer), then that suffices for him, and there is no repetition upon him.

So the proper way of understanding it here as well is what we have mentioned: that if he remembers that he had not performed istinjāʾ with water, although he had performed istinjāʾ with stones, then at that point it is recommended for him to leave the salat (prayer) so long as he is still in it, perform istinjāʾ with water, and repeat the salat (prayer). But if he has already left it, then nothing is upon him. And if he had not performed istinjāʾ at all, then repeating the salat (prayer) would be obligatory upon him in every case, whether he left or did not leave, according to what we have explained. And what further clarifies that is:

key_terms.إِعَادَةُ: repetition, here repetition of the salat (prayer)
key_terms.الْحَجَرِ: stone, referring to cleansing with stones
key_terms.الْخَلَاءِ: the place of relieving oneself; used here for relieving oneself
key_terms.الْمَاءِ: water, the means of cleansing mentioned in the explanation
key_terms.صَلَاتِهِ: his salat (prayer), the ritual prayer being discussed
key_terms.يَسْتَنْجِ: to perform istinjāʾ, cleansing after relieving oneself
key_terms.يَنْصَرِفُ: he leaves or exits the prayer
key_terms.يُعِيدُ: he repeats the act, here the salat (prayer)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone remembers during salat (prayer) that he did not perform istinjāʾ?
ai.summary: This report discusses the ruling for someone who remembers during salat (prayer) that he did not perform istinjāʾ after relieving himself. The apparent ruling is that if he remembers during the prayer, he leaves, performs istinjāʾ, and repeats the prayer; if he remembers after finishing, there is no repetition. The appended explanation distinguishes between not using water after using stones, and not having performed istinjāʾ at all.
